title: UBARv2: Towards Mitigating Exposure Bias in Task-Oriented Dialogs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating task completion (Inform and Success rates) and response quality (BLEU score) on the MultiWOZ benchmark for multi-turn task-oriented dialogs. The evaluation measures the performance degradation and error propagation caused by the distributional shift between training (where the model sees ground-truth context) and inference (where the model must rely on its own generated context).
